svg.title: Lancieux / Dos Aguas — local bending moment
svg.desc: Local My bending moment in bay F06–F08 and purlin P04.2, under 1.35 G plus 1.50 S, scenario S0. Diagram scale 0.12 m per kN·m. Original geometry, colours and support symbols retained; page annotations and dimension line removed. Numerical legend provided separately by the portfolio.
